topic: Student march threshold, response attribution and wider March coverage
description: S002 reports a 1 March student march in central N’Djamena over teacher salary payment and state-force intervention, but no simultaneous attendance. It says the student crowd merged with separate political demonstrators; attribution for property damage and armed abductions is unclear. FOC postponed its scheduled 21 March march. Coverage across provinces and sectors is incomplete.
follow_up: Seek permitted independent reports on 1 March attendance, event boundaries, response and outcome; search March actions in provinces and other sectors. Do not infer ≥50 from abductions or merge the political crowd without evidence.
